# ----- LOAD DATA with baseline scales -----

```{r data}

data_eo <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_data/EO_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")
data_ec <- read.table("/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_data/EC_relpower_behavbl.csv", header=T, sep=",")

data_eo$Drug <- factor(data_eo$Drug)
data_eo$TP <- factor(data_eo$TP)
data_eo$id <- factor(data_eo$id)

data_ec$Drug <- factor(data_ec$Drug)
data_ec$TP <- factor(data_ec$TP)
data_ec$id <- factor(data_ec$id)

# add scaling???

# SPLIT DATA between ot and pl

data_eo_ot_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==1,]
data_eo_pl_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==2,]

data_ec_ot_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==1,]
data_ec_pl_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==2,]
```

# ----- CHECK BASELINE DIFFERENCES -----

```{r baseline-t-tests}
path_to_base = "//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_results/behav_baseline_checks/RR_OTPH_behav_base0_ttests.txt"
sink(path_to_base)

# Alertness
alertness_base_ot <- data_eo$Alertness_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
alertness_base_pl <- data_eo$Alertness_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]
# Excitement
excitement_base_ot <- data_eo$Excitement_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
excitement_base_pl <- data_eo$Excitement_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]
# Sociability
sociability_base_ot <- data_eo$Sociability_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
sociability_base_pl <- data_eo$Sociability_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]

# ttests
alertness_baseline_t = t.test(alertness_base_ot, alertness_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("ALERTNESS")
print(alertness_baseline_t)

excitement_baseline_t = t.test(excitement_base_ot, excitement_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("EXCITEMENT")
print(excitement_baseline_t)

sociability_baseline_t = t.test(sociability_base_ot, sociability_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("SOCIABILITY")
print(sociability_baseline_t)

sink()
```

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# -------------------------------Baseline 1------------------------------------
# form <- "lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP*Drug*Alertness_base + (1|id), data=data_ec)"
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r baseline-1, echo=FALSE}


path_to_base = "//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new/rr_results/behav_baseline_checks/RR_OTPH_behav_base1.txt"
sink(path_to_base)


form <- "lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP*Drug*Alertness_base + (1|id), data=data_ec)"
eff_found <- c()

cat("\n\n")
cat("\n++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++FORMULA++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++-\n")
cat("\n++++++++++++", form, "+++++++++++\n")
cat("\n\n")


# LOOP THROUGH EYE OPEN/CLOSED
for (eyes_cond in c("eyes_open", "eyes_closed")){
  
  # chose the right data depending on eyes cond
  if (eyes_cond == "eyes_open") {
    mydata_main   <- data_eo
    mydata_ot_all <- data_eo_ot_all
    mydata_pl_all <- data_eo_pl_all
  } else {
    mydata_main   <- data_ec
    mydata_ot_all <- data_ec_ot_all
    mydata_pl_all <- data_ec_pl_all
  } 

  # LOOP THROUGH BANDS
  bands <- c("Theta", "Alpha", "Beta")
  for (band in bands) {
  
    # LOOP THROUGH BEHAV MEASURES
    behav_vars <- c("Alertness", "Excitement", "Sociability")
    
    for (behav_var in behav_vars) {
      mybehav <-paste0(behav_var, "_reversed")
      mybase <-paste0(behav_var, "_base_reversed")
      
      
      # do the analysis for this eyes condition, band, measure
      cat("\n-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
      cat("\n-------------------------------------------EYES = ", eyes_cond, "--------------------------------------------\n")
      cat("\n----------------------------------------------BAND = ", band, "----------------------------------------------\n")
      cat("\n------------------------------------------MEASURE = ", behav_var, "------------------------------------------\n")
      cat("\n-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
    

      formula_str1 <- paste0(band, " ~ ", band, "_base + TP*Drug*", mybase, " + (1|id)")

      # save formula in output txt
      cat("\n\n")
      cat(formula_str1)
      cat("\n\n")
      
      model1 <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str1), data = mydata_main)  
      #cat("=== MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
      #print(summary(model1))
      cat("\n============================ TYPE III ANOVA =============================\n")
      a <- anova(model1, type = 3)
      print(a)

      # if anova shows significant main or interaction --> update list of significant results
      
      effects <- c(paste0("Drug:", behav_var))      
      for (effect in effects) {
        if (a[effect, "Pr(>F)"] < 0.05) {
          eff_found <- c(
            eff_found,
            sprintf(
              "%s: %s, %s --> signif: %s -- %s",
              eyes_cond, band, behav_var, effect, a[effect, "Pr(>F)"]))}}
    }}}

cat("\n=========================================================\n\n")
cat("============ Found Drug:Behav_base interaction ==========\n\n")
cat("=========================================================\n\n")
print(eff_found)
cat("=========================================================\n\n")

#return control back to console
sink()
```
